firm_data.firm_description: Squire Patton Boggs is a full-service international law firm that provides insight at the point where law, business, and government meet, giving a voice, supporting ambitions, and achieving successful outcomes. With a multidisciplinary team of over 1,500 lawyers in over 40 offices across four continents.

ai_contact.ai_notes: Squire Patton Boggs has an AI Law & Policy Hub. The AI Law & Policy Leadership includes:

additional_contacts.title: Partner, Global Intellectual Property & Technology Practice Group Leader

email.to_title: Partner, Global Intellectual Property & Technology Practice Group Leader
email.subject: AI for Squire Patton Boggs — scaling across 40 offices
email.body:
Hi David,

With 1,500 lawyers spanning 40 offices across four continents, Squire Patton Boggs operates at a scale where AI becomes essential—not just for efficiency, but for consistency across jurisdictions. Your AI Law & Policy Hub shows you're already thinking ahead on this.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for firms that need precision, client trust, and seamless workflows across geographies. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we understand how global practices actually work.

Given your leadership in IP & Technology, I'd love to show you how we're helping firms like yours leverage AI without compromising the bespoke service your clients expect.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
